Why-Most-Modern-Websites-Fail: Modern websites often fail because they prioritize visual design over system thinking. Developers focus heavily on front-end aesthetics, animations, and UI polish, while ignoring backend structure, API efficiency, and state management. As a result, pages feel heavy, slow, and unoptimized. A truly modern website should not feel like a "showpiece" or movie scene, but like a fast, functional system where every button, request, and interaction has a clear purpose and logic behind it. A production website should be built with a system mindset, structured around efficient data flow and tech stack choices.
Reality-of-a-student-founder-in-london: University gives structure, but real solving, system design and execution happens outside the classroom. As a student founder, I had to balance academics with building a startup. If you think studying in a top tier university, learning uni resources and making good grades can make you a strong engineer, you are in a big delusion. You need to think out of the boundaries and be focused on what's happening in the real world. First identify the problem, then acquire the skills to solve it. Being a student founder, I needed to manage clients remotely between London and Bangladesh with real challenges.Communication,trust-building  and client acquisition are often harder than development itself. Without face-to-face interaction, you have to rely on clarity, consistency, and results to earn trust.At the same time, balancing part-time work, university responsibilities, and long development hours makes time management critical. Most days require deep focus and long hours of coding, which leaves very little room for inefficiency. This environment forces discipline, adaptability, and the ability to think beyond structured learning
The-Rise-of-Vibe-Coding: Vibe coding is changing how software is built. With AI tools, developers can now generate full applications quickly without writing every line of code. The focus is shifting from manual coding to guiding systems, defining logic, and iterating fast.Even tech leaders, including Sundar Pichai, have explored AI tools like Replit to understand how far this shift has gone. It shows a clear reality: building an app has become easy, but building a real product is still complex.Generating code is not the same as building a secure or scalable system. Without knowledge of backend logic, security, and system design, the output may work but will not be production-ready.Vibe coding is powerful, but it does not replace engineering fundamentals. AI speeds up development, but real understanding is still required to build safe and reliable software.
When-You-run-npm-Install-And-Pray: Every developer knows this moment. You clone a project, open the terminal, and type the most powerful spell in web development: npm install.At first, everything feels normal. Files start downloading, dependencies are being installed,Then it happens."Warings"  "Conflicts"  "Failed to install"  "Missing dependencies"  "Version mismatches"  "Peer dependency issues"  "Outdated packages"  "Security vulnerabilities"  "Build errors"  "Runtime errors"  "Unexpected token"  "Syntax errors"  "Module not found"  "Cannot find module"  "Permission denied" "Network errors"  "Timeouts"  "Memory leaks"  "Performance issues" Suddenly, your simple project feels like a battlefield. You did not even write code yet, but now you are solving 47 issues you do not understand.
